# Fredy Rodriguez

> Backend & automation engineer based in Neiva, Colombia. Turns manual processes into robust backend services, AI agents and scalable automations: Go and Python APIs, n8n workflows, WhatsApp bots and MCP servers.

Fredy Rodriguez is a software developer with a Tecnologo degree in Systems Analysis and Development (SENA, 2017) who is currently studying Telecommunications Engineering at UNAD. He works across backend (Go, Python, PostgreSQL), infrastructure (Linux, Docker, Podman, CI/CD) and AI automation (n8n, AI agents, MCP servers, LLM failover). The site is available in Spanish and English. Available for remote work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fredyrn.com/): services, stack, projects, AI & automation and contact.
- [About](https://fredyrn.com/pages/about.html): background, what he builds, education and certifications.

## Services

- Backend APIs and services (Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker)
- Business automation with n8n: ETL/ELT, approval flows, secured webhooks (HMAC, OAuth2, mTLS)
- WhatsApp bots: quotes, scheduling, invoicing
- AI agents and MCP servers (LLM integrations with DeepSeek, Gemini, GPT)
- Web scraping and data extraction (Python, Playwright)
- Docker packaging and VPS deployment (Podman, Traefik/Nginx)

## Projects

- [CI/CD Pipeline for Go Services](https://github.com/FredyRN/digital-barp): CI/CD pipeline for a Go application running in Docker (build, test, deploy).
- [Music21 Score Generator](https://github.com/FredyRN/music_21): generates musical scores from pitch classes with dynamic transpositions (Python).
- WhatsApp Bot to Quote to Invoice: n8n workflow that answers price requests with catalog and 19% VAT and generates the invoice PDF automatically.
- MCP Server - Catalog & Quotes: exposes a product catalog and quote generation to any AI client through the Model Context Protocol.
